scenes.title: Sign in with Seeker
sentences: Losing a bag should not mean losing the way to get it back. This is Seeker Tag, running on a real Solana Seeker.
I choose Continue with Seeker, select my wallet, and approve Sign In With Solana in Seed Vault.
The app opens my items. My wallet is my identity.

scenes.title: Create a tag and reserve a reward
sentences: I add a new item, Seeker Backpack, choose its category, and add a private note.
The public message tells whoever finds it how to contact me, without exposing my phone number.
I add a reward of zero point zero one SOL and set a one hour reservation.
Before signing, the app shows the devnet network, wallet, transaction fee, and account creation cost.
I approve the deposit in Seed Vault. After network confirmation, the reward is reserved on chain.

scenes.title: QR, printable PDF and NFC
sentences: Here is the unique Q R code for this backpack.
I download the P D F and open its preview: six printable formats, with actual sizes and a scale check.
The same item link can also be written to an N F C tag. This screen is ready for a physical tag.

scenes.title: Two people. One private conversation.
sentences: On a separate Android session, Alex opens that same tag as the finder. The reserved reward is visible.
No account is required to notify the owner. Alex enters a name and sends a message.
Now both sides are on screen. I reply from the Seeker, and Alex receives it and answers from the second session.
We arrange the return inside the app, keeping personal contact details private.

scenes.title: Confirm the recipient and release the reward
sentences: To receive the reward, Alex opens item details and confirms a receiving wallet.
With Seed Vault, I sign a message proving ownership of the receiving address. It does not authorize a transfer.
Back on the Seeker, I open the item from our conversation and choose Finish return.
The review shows the finder receiving zero point zero zero nine five SOL, and the five percent service fee.
After confirming the simulated handover, I sign the payout with the owner wallet.

scenes.title: Return confirmed. Reward released.
sentences: The transaction is confirmed on Solana devnet. The reward is released, and both conversations show the completed return.
One tag, private coordination, and a verifiable reward. That is Seeker Tag.
